provider: Project Alexandria - Cloudflare's recurring OSS credit programme

free_tier.stated: Recurring annual credits, amount set per project. Explicitly includes 'Increased R2 storage for builds and artifacts' and 'Increased requests to Cloudflare Workers and Pages'.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: R2 object size: 5 TiB per object; maximum upload size 5 GiB (single-part) / 4.995 TiB (multi-part).
per_object_cap.notes: The published R2 limits give 5 TiB per object and a 5 GiB single-part / 4.995 TiB multi-part maximum upload size.

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: Standard storage minimum duration: None. Infrequent Access storage minimum duration: 30 days.

egress.terms: There are no charges for egress bandwidth for any storage class.

tooling: R2 is S3-compatible (rclone 's3' with Cloudflare provider, aws CLI, wrangler). Pages via git/wrangler deploy.
chaining: Apply to receive recurring annual credits with Project Alexandria.
limits_note: Must 'maintain an open source project with a recognized OSS license' and 'operate solely on a non-profit basis'. Requires a payment method on file. Acceptance and amount are at Cloudflare's sole discretion; programme can be discontinued at any time.

extras.quota_verbatim: Recurring annual credits, amount set per project. Explicitly includes 'Increased R2 storage for builds and artifacts' and 'Increased requests to Cloudflare Workers and Pages'.
extras.limits_verbatim: Must 'maintain an open source project with a recognized OSS license' and 'operate solely on a non-profit basis'. Requires a payment method on file. Acceptance and amount are at Cloudflare's sole discretion; programme can be discontinued at any time.
extras.egress_verbatim: R2 egress is free to the internet; Workers/Pages requests are included in the credit.
extras.chaining_verbatim: Annual renewal is the whole point: unlike the one-shot startup credits, this is stated as 'recurring annual credits'. A maintainer with several OSS projects can plausibly hold several grants; credits are per project, non-transferable.
extras.tooling_verbatim: R2 is S3-compatible (rclone 's3' with Cloudflare provider, aws CLI, wrangler). Pages via git/wrangler deploy.
extras.agent_focus: Credit, grant and sponsorship programmes that fund storage, assessed on RENEWABILITY rather than headline size. The question is not 'how big is the credit' but 'does it come back next year, and can an unaffiliated individual outside the US/EU hold it'.
